name: sidebar-11
title: Sidebar 11
description: A sidebar with a collapsible file tree: the changed files with their letters in the margin, then the folders, each folding open to any depth. Pick a file and the trail in the header follows it. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-11. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { fileChanges, fileTree, type FileNode } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible" import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarRail, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" const OPEN_BY_DEFAULT = new Set(["components", "components/ui"]) const STATE_NAMES: Record = { M: "modified", U: "untracked" } function fileIcon(name: string) { if (/\.(tsx?|jsx?|json)$/.test(name) || name.startsWith(".")) return "file-code" if (/\.(md|txt)$/.test(name)) return "file-text" return "file" } function Tree({ node, parent, active, onPick }: { node: FileNode; parent: string; active: string; onPick: (path: string) => void }) { const path = parent ? `${parent}/${node.name}` : node.name if (!node.children) { return ( onPick(path)}> {node.name} ) } return ( {node.name} {node.children.map((child) => ( ))} ) } export function AppSidebar({ active, onPick, ...props }: React.ComponentProps & { active: string; onPick: (path: string) => void }) { return ( Changes {fileChanges.map((change) => ( onPick(change.file)}> {change.file} {change.state} {STATE_NAMES[change.state] ?? change.state} ))} Files {fileTree.map((node) => ( ))} ) }

"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-11/components/sidebar-11-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  const [active, setActive] = React.useState("components/ui/button.tsx")
  const parts = active.split("/")
  const file = parts[parts.length - 1]!

  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={cn("overflow-x-clip", c.provider)}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} active={active} onPick={setActive} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={parts} bordered />
        <PageBody title={file} kicker={parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).join(" / ") : "project root"}>
          <PageNote title="No editor here yet" pose="think">
            This is where {file} would open. Pick another file on the pad and the trail above follows you.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
